name: Stranded in Space
storyline:
You wake up on a spaceship filled only with women traveling to another planet, unaware of how you got there.
You must navigate your days aboard the Endurance, making key decisions about your relationships with your shipmates,
while trying to figure out the larger mysteries at play involving your reason for being on the ship,
and why its destination to the sanctuary planet of Elysium isn't going according to plan.
You are Stranded in Space!
summary: Stranded in Space is an erotic sci-fi Visual Novel about a man who wakes up on a spaceship filled only with women. Meet a huge cast of beautiful girls, unravel the connected mysteries, and have a ton of sex within a story acclaimed for its comedy and writing.
